description: Recommended interventions. Each rule's conditions are read from the saved alert; when they hold, its action is recommended with the reasons that matched. Lower priority number = more urgent.

COLLECTIONS_CONTACT.title: Collections contact and repayment plan
COLLECTIONS_CONTACT.detail: Contact the customer, confirm the cause of the arrears and agree a dated repayment plan before the next instalment.

ISLAMIC_RESCHEDULE.title: Reschedule without additional profit
ISLAMIC_RESCHEDULE.detail: If a restructure is needed, reschedule the Murabaha/Ijarah instalments without increasing the amount owed; late-payment charges go to charity, not income.

RM_REPAYMENT_CALL.title: RM call on repayment pattern
RM_REPAYMENT_CALL.detail: Call the customer about repeated late or partial payments; check for salary or receivable delays and update the account notes.

FREEZE_LIMITS.title: Freeze limit increases and review debt burden
FREEZE_LIMITS.detail: Hold any further limit increases or new facilities; recalculate total obligations against current inflows.

RM_CASHFLOW_REVIEW.title: RM cash-flow review before a payment is missed
RM_CASHFLOW_REVIEW.detail: Review recent bank statements with the customer and discuss working-capital support or restructuring options while repayments are still current.

SME_DOCUMENTS.title: Request tax returns and debtor list
SME_DOCUMENTS.detail: Request the latest GST/VAT returns and an aged debtor list to confirm turnover and how quickly the business is being paid.

REQUEST_EVIDENCE.title: Ask for evidence of the missed payment's cause
REQUEST_EVIDENCE.detail: The isolated late payment has no supporting document on file; request one so the exception can be confirmed.

SECTOR_REVIEW.title: Flag for sector review
SECTOR_REVIEW.detail: This customer is part of a detected risk cluster; review the segment as a whole at the next credit committee.

COLLECT_DATA.title: Collect missing data
COLLECT_DATA.detail: Obtain the missing repayment, transaction or exposure history so the customer can be scored.

UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY_CHECK.title: Sense-check unusual account behaviour
UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY_CHECK.detail: The unusual-behaviour model flagged a combination of changes that no specific rule covers; review the listed drivers and confirm whether there is a benign explanation.

NEXT_CYCLE_CHECK.title: Re-check at next monitoring cycle
NEXT_CYCLE_CHECK.detail: No immediate action; confirm the trend at the next monthly review.
